claims.head: The Stars will send Lindell and Heiskanen at Scheifele
claims.call: The Stars’ P1 (Lindell and Heiskanen) spends at least 48% of its 5-on-5 time against the Jets’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Stars keep sending Lindell and Heiskanen out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Glen Gulutzan has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Jets’ first line is Scheifele, Connor and Perfetti.

claims.gist: At home, Glen Gulutzan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Jets’ first line.

claims.head: Don’t buy Skinner’s slump against the Stars
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Skinner has been shaky against the Stars, well below his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if he’s back to his usual self.
claims.nums: 7 starts against Dallas: .832 save percentage · .900 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Skinner’s record against the Stars.
claims.call: If Skinner starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .900 than to his .832 against the Stars.

notes.text: Josh Morrissey is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Mario Ferraro has taken his spot beside Dylan DeMelo.
Jack St. Ivany is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, down from 35% with his old team last season.
Wyatt Johnston is out (illness) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward.
Matt Duchene is on long-term injured reserve (abdomen injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.

DAL.head: The Stars have a lot going for them
DAL.body: Even though Dallas will be without Johnston, the Stars have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage, and Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. The Jets can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

WPG.head: The Jets have a hill to climb
WPG.body: Even though Dallas will be without Johnston, the Stars have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and have home-ice advantage, and Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. The Jets’ best way through is keeping shots to a minimum.

story.head: Winnipeg at Dallas
paras: The Jets come in at 4-1-2, the Stars at 3-3-1.

items.text: The Jets have been without Josh Morrissey since Oct 7, and have had to make do without Connor Hellebuyck all season. Stuart Skinner is expected to start.
The Stars are newly without Wyatt Johnston, and have had to make do without Matt Duchene all season.
Kyle Connor has scored in four straight games.
Mark Scheifele has a point in four straight games.
